entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's soooo hot...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's as if we're walking around[n]in an enormous sauna...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whose bright idea was it to come here?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yours...

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: ...and just look at that crowd![n]Smiling faces everywhere you look!

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: With that, let's move right into asking[n]some of the visitors here for their[n]comments!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A TV crew, eh...?
We'd better not stand out...
We can't end up on TV.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We should grab our kebabs and[n]get outta here.

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: Ah, let's interview those three.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hey, is she talking about us?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do we do,[n][fName]?
Let's just calm down.
Let's make a run for it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Good point. We'll look even more[n]suspicious if we panic now.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That would just make us appear even[n]more suspicious.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: They got us!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw, hell...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Okay, I'm gonna ham it up and make[n]some real cringey comments so they[n]can't use any of the footage.

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: Hello! It sure is hot today, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, for sure, yeah!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And if it's this hot in July, can you imagine[n]just how insane the weather's gonna be[n]in December?

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: Ah, anyway... Since you're here for the[n]festival, does that mean you and your[n]friends there are meat lovers?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'd say that we're really lovers of fruit! Oh,[n]and sweets! Sweets are just to DIE for!

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: Eheheh...

entries.speaker: Female Host
entries.en: Well, ah... Thank you very much for[n]your time!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Phew, that was too close...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That was truly cringeworthy, but are you[n]certain that they won't air any of it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm pretty sure she thought that was a[n]broadcast disaster. We oughta be okay.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: More important than that, though:[n]it's time to get some MEAT!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, right! My kebab!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The lines for the food stalls were even[n]more insane than the heat!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Standing around in this sweltering[n]heat was rather trying.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And almost all the good stuff was[n]already sold out...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I didn't even eat breakfast this morning.[n]I'm starting to get lightheaded...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even still, an occasion like this seems[n]to make everything taste delicious...[n]How mysterious.
It's because we're together.
What a great time.
I really wanted a kebab...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's pretty poetic, dude.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle* Even with this sticky[n]sweatiness included.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: B-But look, [fName]—at least we have[n]shaved ice!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Welp, we came all the way out here,[n]so we might as well go check that[n]thing out.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What thing?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I heard they're building some kinda[n]huge-ass stadium or somethin'[n]nearby. Wait, was that what it was?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't know what you're talking[n]about, do you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A stadium...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, such buildings often have[n]intriguing architecture—I'd love[n]to see it for personal reference.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah? Then c'mon, let's go.
